definitions: To return something to its original position or place after it has been removed.
To resume wearing an item of clothing or accessory.
To regain weight that was previously lost.
examples: Please put the book back on the shelf.
She put her hat back on after the wind died down.
He was careful not to put the weight back on after his diet.
pastTenses: put back on (past simple), put back on (present perfect)
